title: Observation of spin-crossover behaviour in Co(II)-terpyridine complexes possessing π-conjugated substations
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35892-35898
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08657K, Paper

Keita Soejima, Yoshihiro Sekine, Kanta Miyake, Kota Kiba, Yuito Yamaguchi, Hikaru Zenno, Shinya Hayami
A series of Co(II)-terpyridine complexes [Co(R-ethynyl-terpy)2](BF4)2 (R = phenyl for 1, naphthyl for 2, anthracenyl for 3, and pyrenyl for 4), was prepared. The magnetic and luminescent properties were investigated.
